title: Default strike distances of the ready-mades (G-15-3)
reference_behaviour: Defaults: spreads about 1% of spot wide (NIFTY 4 steps), short strangle at ATM plus and minus 4 steps, iron condor shorts 4 steps out with 4-step wings, ratio back spread sold at ATM and bought 4 steps out.
ours: Our catalogue defaults are overnight ADR-045 values, mostly 2 steps (iron condor 2 and 2, short strangle 2); only the four vertical spreads match. Data-only change under REQ-079 AC-3, still held for Q211.
